title: Understanding Bias in Models
text: When you add a new feature to a model, especially one that is a transformation of an existing feature, think about how it might help the model capture more complex patterns in the data. How does this affect the model's ability to fit the training data?

title: Effect of Adding Features
text: Adding a feature that is a transformation of an existing feature can allow the model to fit the data more closely. Consider how this might reduce the error due to bias.
